pipelines.name: Build docs

steps.name: 🪓 Remove some stuff we don't need
steps.run:
sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/share/boost"
sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"

steps.name: 🟢 Install stuff we need
steps.run:
type -p curl >/dev/null || (sudo apt update && sudo apt install curl -y)
curl -fsSL https://cli.github.com/packages/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg | sudo dd of=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
&& sudo chmod go+r /usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg \
&& echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/githubcli-archive-keyring.gpg] https://cli.github.com/packages stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/github-cli.list > /dev/null \
&& sudo apt update \
&& sudo apt install gh -y

steps.name: 📁Move repository to /mnt
steps.run:
sudo mv /home/runner/work/airflow-site/airflow-site /mnt/
# Create symbolic link
sudo mkdir -p /home/runner/work/airflow-site
sudo ln -s /mnt/airflow-site /home/runner/work/airflow-site/airflow-site

steps.name: Ensure cache directory exists and adjust permissions
🔎 Lint
steps.run:
uv tool install prek
prek run --all-files --color always

steps.name: 🗂 Checkout ${{ env.PUBLISH_BRANCH }} branch with minimum depth
📦 Save previous sphinx_airflow_theme packages from publish branch
steps.run:
if [ -d dist/sphinx-airflow-theme ]; then
  echo "Saving previous theme packages:"
  ls -la dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/
  cp -r dist/sphinx-airflow-theme /tmp/sphinx-airflow-theme-backup
else
  echo "No previous theme packages found"
fi

steps.name: 📦 Restore previous sphinx_airflow_theme packages
steps.run:
if [ -d /tmp/sphinx-airflow-theme-backup ]; then
  mkdir -p dist/sphinx-airflow-theme
  cp -r /tmp/sphinx-airflow-theme-backup/* dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/
  echo "Restored previous theme packages:"
  ls -la dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/
fi

steps.name: 🧪 Apply staging modifications: .htaccess and watermarks
steps.run:
set -x
sed -i 's/d7fnmbhf26p21.cloudfront.net/d3a2du7x0n8ydr.cloudfront.net/' ./dist/.htaccess
echo "Updated ./dist/.htaccess"
cat ./dist/.htaccess
echo
uv run .github/scripts/add_watermark.py --pattern 'main*.css' \
--folder dist --image-directory images --url-prefix /images

steps.name: 👷 Copy .asf.yaml to /dist/
steps.run:
# The asf.yaml file must be in the branch from which the files are published.
# Otherwise, ASF publishing tools cannot detect it.
cp .asf.yaml ./dist/

steps.name: 🔧 Copy files from site to theme
🔍 Check if sphinx_airflow_theme changed
steps.run:
NEW_VERSION=$(cat sphinx_airflow_theme/LATEST_VERSION.txt | tr -d '[:space:]')
PUBLISHED_VERSION=""
if [ -f dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/LATEST_VERSION.txt ]; then
  PUBLISHED_VERSION=$(cat dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/LATEST_VERSION.txt | tr -d '[:space:]')
fi
if [ "${NEW_VERSION}" != "${PUBLISHED_VERSION}" ]; then
  echo "theme_changed=true" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  echo "sphinx_airflow_theme version changed: ${PUBLISHED_VERSION} -> ${NEW_VERSION}"
else
  echo "theme_changed=false" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  echo "sphinx_airflow_theme version unchanged (${NEW_VERSION}), skipping theme upload"
fi

steps.name: 📦 Copy sphinx_airflow_theme package to dist (preserving previous versions)
steps.run:
mkdir -p dist/sphinx-airflow-theme
cp sphinx_airflow_theme/dist/* dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/
cp sphinx_airflow_theme/LATEST_VERSION.txt dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/
echo "All theme packages (including previous versions):"
ls -la dist/sphinx-airflow-theme/

steps.name: 🚀 Add commit to ${{ env.PUBLISH_BRANCH }} branch and deploy it
steps.run:
set -x
echo "Running git config"
git config user.name "GitHub Actions"
git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
# actions/checkout@v6 stores credentials via includeIf gitdir conditions that
# break when the repo is symlinked to /mnt. Set the token explicitly.
git remote set-url origin "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git"
echo "Running git add"
git add .
git diff HEAD
echo "Running git commit"
git commit --no-edit -m "Docs updated via ${GITHUB_REF}:${{ github.sha }}" --allow-empty
echo "Running git push to ${PUBLISH_BRANCH} branch"
git push origin ${PUBLISH_BRANCH}

steps.name: 📚 Build Airflow docs with this theme
🚀 Upload Airflow docs built with this theme as artifact
🚀 Create releases on GitHub
steps.run:
set -x
if [[ "${GITHUB_REF}" == "refs/heads/main" ]]; then
  SUFFIX=""
else
  SUFFIX="-staging"
fi
gh auth status
VERSION="$(cd sphinx_airflow_theme; uv run python -c 'import sphinx_airflow_theme; print(sphinx_airflow_theme.__version__)')"
TITLE=$(date "+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
NOTES="Commit: ${GITHUB_COMMIT}
Source: ${GITHUB_REF}"

gh release delete "${VERSION}${SUFFIX}" -y || true
gh release create "${VERSION}${SUFFIX}" \
  --title "${TITLE}" \
  --notes "${NOTES}" \
  ./dist/*

pipelines.name: Reset staging to main

steps.name: 🚀 Force push main to staging
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
MAIN_SHA="$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
STAGING_SHA="$(git rev-parse origin/staging)"
echo "Previous staging: ${STAGING_SHA}"
echo "New staging (main): ${MAIN_SHA}"
{
  echo "### Reset staging to main"
  echo ""
  echo "- Previous staging: \`${STAGING_SHA}\`"
  echo "- New staging: \`${MAIN_SHA}\`"
} >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
if [[ "${MAIN_SHA}" == "${STAGING_SHA}" ]]; then
  echo "staging already points to main, nothing to push."
  exit 0
fi
git push --force-with-lease="staging:${STAGING_SHA}" \
  "https://x-access-token:${GITHUB_TOKEN}@github.com/${REPOSITORY}.git" \
  "${MAIN_SHA}:refs/heads/staging"

steps.name: 🔧 Trigger "Build docs" on staging
steps.run:
# Pushes made with GITHUB_TOKEN do not trigger other workflows,
# so the staging build has to be dispatched explicitly.
gh workflow run build.yml --repo "${REPOSITORY}" --ref staging

findings: [LOW] NO_TIMEOUT: Job 'reset-staging' omits 'timeout-minutes', risking 360-minute hung runners.

anti_patterns.remediation: Set an explicit 'timeout-minutes:' value on every job (for example, timeout-minutes: 15).
